If the event occurs without this introduction, NO; cancellation beyond the window is unresolved.

claim: US core CPI rises 0.2% or 0.3% in August
resolution_rule: YES if the initial September 11 BLS release reports August CPI-U, all items less food and energy, at 0.2% or 0.3% month over month, seasonally adjusted. Use the published rounded figure, not later revisions.

claim: The US Open men’s final lasts at least four completed sets
resolution_rule: YES if the 2026 US Open men’s singles final ends with four or five fully completed sets in the official score. A completed three-set final is NO. Retirement, walkover, disqualification or an unfinished match is unresolved regardless of partial-set count. If postponed, use a completed final by September 22; otherwise unresolved.

claim: Blizzard announces a new standalone StarCraft video game
resolution_rule: YES if Blizzard officially announces a previously unannounced standalone StarCraft video game after this cutoff and by September 22, 23:59 UTC. A named game or an explicit new-game development announcement qualifies. Exclude remasters, ports, expansions, patches, tabletop games, merchandise, collaborations inside other games, and unexplained teasers. NO if no qualifying announcement appears in Blizzard’s official news and event record by the deadline; unresolved if that record cannot be checked. September 13 is the expected reveal opportunity, not the scoring deadline.

claim: The Pitt wins Outstanding Drama Series
resolution_rule: YES if the Television Academy names The Pitt the winner or an official co-winner of Outstanding Drama Series at the September 14, 2026 ceremony. Any other sole winner is NO. Use the Academy’s category result, not acting or Creative Arts awards. If the category is not awarded by September 22, leave unresolved.

claim: No new Atlantic tropical cyclone through September 14 noon UTC
resolution_rule: YES if NHC operational advisories identify no newly formed tropical or subtropical depression or storm in the Atlantic basin after this cutoff through September 14, 12:00 UTC. A new depression counts and makes the forecast NO even if it is never named. A potential tropical cyclone designation alone does not count. Use advisory issue times; if the advisory archive cannot be checked completely, unresolved. Later best-track reanalysis does not change this operational-reporting test.

claim: Salesforce shows two distinct agents handing off one business workflow at Dreamforce
resolution_rule: YES if Salesforce publishes a Dreamforce September 15–17 demonstration or recording after this cutoff and by September 22 showing two distinct software agents with different roles, an explicit handoff of task or context, and a displayed result within the same business workflow. A diagram, future promise, two unrelated chat windows, or one agent merely calling a conventional tool does not qualify. Prerecorded product demos count, but must be labeled as such in the resolution. NO if a complete check of official Dreamforce recordings and product recap material finds no qualifying demonstration by the deadline; unresolved if the necessary record is unavailable.

claim: A Standard Bots IMTS demo shows a taught task repeated without continuous human control
resolution_rule: YES if an official exhibitor/organizer video or a first-hand technical report published after this cutoff and by September 22 documents a Standard Bots demonstration at IMTS September 14–19 in which a person teaches a physical task and the robot subsequently completes that task without continuous teleoperation or hand guidance. The report must explicitly connect the teaching and execution stages. A generic arm moving, a pre-event clip, slides, or a sales claim without an observed demo is insufficient. NO if a complete check of organizer and exhibitor show reports plus available first-hand coverage finds no qualifying evidence by the deadline; unresolved if evidence access is inadequate.

claim: An IMTS manufacturing cell produces a drone that then flies at the show
resolution_rule: YES if an IMTS/ORNL event report or first-hand technical account published after this cutoff and by September 22 documents at least one quadcopter produced through the announced manufacturing-and-assembly demonstration at IMTS September 14–19 and subsequently flown there. The account must link production and flight to the resulting unit or batch. A drone assembled elsewhere, separate unrelated footage, an airframe alone, or an announced plan does not count. Human integration steps are allowed and must be disclosed when reported. NO if the event concludes and a complete check of IMTS and ORNL show reports plus available first-hand coverage finds no qualifying documented result; unresolved if access is inadequate.

claim: Konami broadcasts actual Project ZIRCON gameplay at Tokyo Game Show
resolution_rule: YES if Konami publishes or broadcasts a Project ZIRCON demonstration after this cutoff and by September 22, 23:59 UTC containing at least one continuous 60-second segment of visibly interactive gameplay. Menus alone, cinematics, a montage without a qualifying segment, slides and repeated older footage do not count. Developer-controlled gameplay qualifies; public download access is not required. NO if a complete check of Konami’s official TGS broadcasts and recap material finds no qualifying segment by the deadline; unresolved if the broadcast record is unavailable.

claim: China leads the Asian Games gold table by September 22
resolution_rule: YES if China is ranked first by gold medals on the official table at September 22, 23:59 Japan time. Break ties by silver then bronze; an exact tie counts as joint first and YES. If no medals have been awarded or no official tally is recoverable, leave unresolved.

claim: Muse still requires approval before purchases
resolution_rule: YES if Meta’s current official Muse documentation at September 22, 23:59 UTC explicitly retains a requirement for user approval before making purchases. NO if current official documentation explicitly permits purchases without such approval, including a newly introduced autonomous-spending mode. If the current rule is absent, ambiguous or inaccessible, leave unresolved. A launch article alone is insufficient if newer documentation supersedes it. This tests the published permission policy, not whether every real execution obeys it.

claim: Progress 96 docks with the ISS by September 22
resolution_rule: YES if NASA or the spacecraft operator confirms completed docking of Progress 96 to the ISS after this cutoff and by September 22, 23:59 UTC. Liftoff, orbit insertion, an approach or a rescheduled appointment is insufficient. NO if reliable mission reporting establishes no docking by then, including delay or failure; unresolved if status cannot be established.

claim: Crew-13 has not launched by September 22
resolution_rule: YES if Crew-13 has not lifted off by September 22, 23:59 UTC. NO if an actual Crew-13 liftoff occurs after this cutoff and before that deadline, even if the flight later aborts. A rehearsal, static-fire test or new target date is not liftoff. Use official NASA/SpaceX mission reporting; leave unresolved if a reliable status cannot be established.
